places.name: The Sumida Hokusai Museum
places.connection: The museum is dedicated to the life and works of Katsushika Hokusai, the main subject of the film.

places.name: Edo-Tokyo Museum
places.connection: Provides historical context of the Edo period, which is depicted in the film.

places.name: Asakusa
places.connection: Asakusa is a historical area in Tokyo that reflects the Edo period setting of the film.

places.name: Ueno Park
places.connection: Ueno Park is a cultural hub in Tokyo, often associated with traditional Japanese art and history.

places.name: Tokyo National Museum
places.connection: Houses a vast collection of Edo period art, similar to the artwork featured in the film.
